verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents running large concurrent fleets of sandboxes or publishes concurrency limits such as maximum concurrent sandboxes or instance quotas. The closest item (docs-17) covers multiplexing SDK calls over one connection to avoid subrequest limits, which concerns operations within a single sandbox, not fleet-level concurrency. getSandbox-by-ID and per-sandbox VM isolation show that multiple sandboxes can exist, but say nothing about scale or limits.
